result.stdout:
Usage:
  deppoc --server                         run this user's server (exits 0 at once when one runs)
  deppoc --stop                           stop the running server
  deppoc lint <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>] [--min-level hidden|info|warning|error]
              [--format text|json|sarif] [--output <file>]
  deppoc build <sln|slnx|csproj> <output> [-c <configuration>] [--no-analyzers] [--no-hardlinks]
  deppoc test  <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>] [--all] [--parallel <n>] [--max-failures <n>] [--queue]
              [--exclude <project name, * for any text>]... [--output <folder>] [--no-analyzers] [--format text|json|trx] [--report <file>]
              [-- <test arguments>]
  deppoc clear <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>]
